limitations.subject: Network transport generalization
limitations.boundary: The forced-movement reproduction used a temporary local bare repository under Git 2.43.0. Equivalent races over GitHub HTTPS, SSH, partial clone, promisor remotes, or server garbage collection were not executed because external mutation was prohibited.

limitations.subject: Reachability prerequisite
limitations.boundary: The verifier must acquire pinned commit A while it is reachable. If a fresh verifier starts only after A becomes unadvertised or garbage-collected, fetch of moved branch B cannot guarantee acquisition of A; the mechanism fails closed when A is unavailable.

limitations.subject: SHA-256 Git object-format repository
limitations.boundary: The executable accepts 40- or 64-hex full object IDs, but this reproduction used the runtime's default SHA-1 Git object format. A SHA-256-format repository recurrence was not run.

limitations.subject: Artifact byte shapes
limitations.boundary: Exact readback was exercised with NUL, CRLF, invalid UTF-8 and ordinary LF bytes. Exhaustive file sizes, sparse blobs, Git LFS pointer dereferencing, submodules, symlinks and trees were not claimed; the verifier deliberately accepts blobs only and does not dereference LFS.

limitations.subject: Cryptographic collision resistance
limitations.boundary: No claim is made that SHA-256 collision resistance was independently established. This unit only tests equality against a preregistered digest and byte count.

limitations.subject: Observed reasoning setting
limitations.boundary: The runtime reported model gpt-5.6-sol-max-fast, but exposed no separately attestable observed reasoning level. The immutable input requested xhigh.

limitations.subject: Independent acceptance
limitations.boundary: The producer executed focused and black-box recurrence tests but did not independently accept its own result. Coordinator ingestion, COMPLETED state and independent disposition remain outside this producer return.
